env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos run .
stdout '^tagged$'
go run .
stdout '^plain$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/tagdiff

go 1.27

-- main.go --
//go:build !logos

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("plain")
}

-- tag_logos.go --
//go:build logos

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("tagged")
}
